title: PyData Global 2026
description:
PyData Malaga
PyData Global 2026 is a 2-day virtual event for the international community of data scientists, data engineers, and developers of data analysis tools to share ideas and learn from each other.
During the conference, attendees will have the opportunity to attend live keynote sessions and talks, lightning talks, and get to know fellow members of the PyData Community.

https://pydata.org/global2026

To purchase tickets: https://pydata.org/global2026/tickets
Schedule: https://pretalx.com/pydata-global-2026/schedule/
